verificationPolicy: Cumulative from V32. Added 250 VERIFIED profiles in one batch: 125 ASRock exact real models and 125 GIGABYTE exact model/revision profiles. Revision-specific profiles require the user revision when no wildcard match exists. Physical TPM is only asserted where official platform/module documentation supports it; otherwise the verified firmware TPM route is returned. Hotfix: added exact GIGABYTE B760 GAMING X AX DDR4 profile with official physical TPM mapping. Runtime matcher hotfix: canonicalizes real SMBIOS manufacturer names and strips trailing MSI board IDs such as (MS-7D98) before exact DB matching.
